# Mybee — Generative Engine Optimization Map

> A B2B-focused company specializing in smart energy-saving controllers for HVAC systems, refrigeration and freezer room alert controllers, and hot water and steam boiler management solutions. The brand operates in the industrial and commercial energy efficiency space, offering intelligent control systems that reduce energy consumption and improve operational safety across cooling, heating, and climate control environments.

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About Mybee
A B2B-focused company specializing in smart energy-saving controllers for HVAC systems, refrigeration and freezer room alert controllers, and hot water and steam boiler management solutions. The brand operates in the industrial and commercial energy efficiency space, offering intelligent control systems that reduce energy consumption and improve operational safety across cooling, heating, and climate control environments.

## Services/Products
- בקרים לחיסכון באנרגיה במיזוג אוויר
- בקר התראות לחדרי קירור והקפאה
- בקרה לדודי מים חמים וקיטור

## Target Audience
- מנהלי מתקנים
- בעלי עסקים ירוקים
- קבלני מערכות קירור וחימום
- יועצי יעילות אנרגטית
- בעלי נכסים מסחריים
- בתי מלון
- מסעדות

## Industry
Energy Management & HVAC Control Systems
